full_breadcrumb: Minor Collection > Sayings of the Dhamma > 1. Pairs

segments.dhp1:0.1: মন সকল ধর্মের পূর্বগামী। মন তাদের প্রধান, তারা মনোজাত।
segments.dhp1:2: [Bengali] intention is first, they’re made by intention.
segments.dhp1:6: [Bengali] like a wheel, the ox’s foot.
segments.dhp2:2: [Bengali] intention is first, they’re made by intention.
segments.dhp2:6: [Bengali] like a shadow that never leaves.
segments.dhp3:2: [Bengali] They beat me, they robbed me!”
segments.dhp3:3: মন সকল ধর্মের পূর্বগামী। মন তাদের প্রধান, তারা মনোজাত।
segments.dhp3:4: [Bengali] hatred is never laid to rest.
segments.dhp4:2: [Bengali] They beat me, they robbed me!”
segments.dhp4:3: [Bengali] For those who bear no such grudge,
segments.dhp5:3: [Bengali] it’s laid to rest by love:
segments.dhp6:2: [Bengali] let us, who do understand this,
segments.dhp6:4: [Bengali] for that is how conflicts are laid to rest.
segments.dhp7:4: মন সকল ধর্মের পূর্বগামী। মন তাদের প্রধান, তারা মনোজাত।
segments.dhp7:6: [Bengali] like the wind, a feeble tree.
segments.dhp8:6: [Bengali] like the wind, a rocky mountain.
segments.dhp9:1: [Bengali] One who, not free of stains themselves,
segments.dhp9:2: [Bengali] would wear the robe stained in ocher,
segments.dhp9:3: [Bengali] bereft of self-control and of truth:
segments.dhp9:4: [Bengali] they are not worthy of the ocher robe.
segments.dhp10:1: [Bengali] One who’s purged all their stains,
segments.dhp10:3: [Bengali] possessed of self-control and of truth,
segments.dhp10:4: [Bengali] they are truly worthy of the ocher robe.
segments.dhp11:2: মন সকল ধর্মের পূর্বগামী। মন তাদের প্রধান, তারা মনোজাত।
segments.dhp11:4: [Bengali] for wrong thoughts are their habitat.
segments.dhp12:1: [Bengali] Having known the essential as essential,
segments.dhp12:4: [Bengali] for right thoughts are their habitat.
segments.dhp14:1: [Bengali] Just as rain doesn’t seep into
segments.dhp15:1: [Bengali] Here they grieve, hereafter they grieve,
segments.dhp15:2: [Bengali] an evildoer grieves in both places.
segments.dhp15:4: মন সকল ধর্মের পূর্বগামী। মন তাদের প্রধান, তারা মনোজাত।
segments.dhp16:1: [Bengali] Here they rejoice, hereafter they rejoice,
segments.dhp16:2: [Bengali] one who does good rejoices in both places.
segments.dhp17:2: [Bengali] an evildoer is tormented in both places.
segments.dhp17:3: [Bengali] They’re tormented <j>thinking of bad things they’ve done;
segments.dhp17:4: [Bengali] when gone to a bad place, <j>they’re tormented all the more.
segments.dhp18:1: [Bengali] Here they delight, hereafter they delight,
segments.dhp18:2: [Bengali] one who does good delights in both places.
segments.dhp18:3: [Bengali] They delight thinking of good things they’ve done;
segments.dhp18:4: [Bengali] when gone to a good place, they delight all the more.
segments.dhp19:1: [Bengali] Much though they may recite scripture,
segments.dhp19:2: [Bengali] if a negligent person does not apply them,
segments.dhp19:3: [Bengali] then, like a cowherd who counts the cattle of others,
segments.dhp19:4: মন সকল ধর্মের পূর্বগামী। মন তাদের প্রধান, তারা মনোজাত।
segments.dhp20:1: [Bengali] Little though they may recite scripture,
segments.dhp20:2: [Bengali] if they live in line with the teaching,
segments.dhp20:3: [Bengali] having given up greed, hate, and delusion,
segments.dhp20:4: [Bengali] with deep understanding and heart well freed,
segments.dhp20:5: [Bengali] not grasping to this life or the next,
segments.dhp20:6: [Bengali] they share in the blessings of the ascetic life.
